name: Watchexec Open-Source File-Watcher CLI
free_limit: Apache-2.0 licensed local file-change watcher that runs configured commands on filesystem events; no license fee, account or vendor-metered limit.
watch_out: Runs on user-managed Windows, macOS or Linux systems. Triggered builds, CI jobs, external APIs or deployment commands can incur their own charges or side effects; no hosted compute or monitoring service is included. Apache-2.0 obligations apply.
